site.intro.en.text:
I turn audience insight into creative that converts — and build AI tools to do it faster.
translate performance data into creative insights that inform iterations and new concepts

nodes.xbox-launch.summary.en.text: I led the creative strategy for Genshin Impact’s Xbox launch campaign across the US, France and Germany. The campaign delivered 120M+ impressions and lifted CTR by 338% against the earlier benchmark.

nodes.xbox-launch.sections.0.items.0.en.text: The launch needed paid media to drive traffic to the Xbox landing page, not just awareness. That meant turning existing brand materials into 144 localized assets, our team’s largest creative test for a paid brand campaign, with tight coordination across languages, platform specs and approvals.

nodes.xbox-launch.sections.1.items.0.en.text: Defined the creative strategy: Used past campaign learnings and regional player insights to build four testable creative concepts, adapted for US, French and German audiences.

nodes.xbox-launch.sections.1.items.1.en.text: Managed creative production: Wrote briefs covering copy, landing-page links and platform specs for all 144 assets, and kept timelines, reviews and approvals on track.

nodes.xbox-launch.sections.1.items.2.en.text: Supported media optimization: Helped shape budget, regional priorities and targeting across YouTube, Meta, X and TikTok, then reviewed live results with the media team to scale winners and pause underperformers.

nodes.xbox-launch.results.1.en.text: lower CPC versus the earlier benchmark

nodes.ua-creative-strategy.summary.en.text: I led the brand team's creative strategy for Genshin Impact's user acquisition, building a creator-led ad pipeline across Japan, North America and Europe. Our creatives delivered ~3.7× projected LTV and 26% higher projected 365-day ROI than the UA benchmark.

nodes.ua-creative-strategy.sections.0.it.text: The UA team's tests showed creator ads scaled and converted well, but they couldn't produce enough of them. The brand team had creator resources but had never worked on user acquisition.

nodes.ua-creative-strategy.sections.1.it.text: Built and evolved the testing framework: Translated acquisition goals into market-specific creative hypotheses, using performance data to steer tests across hooks, creative angles, scripts and formats.
Directed creator production: Briefed creators, developed script templates and reviewed every video before launch.

Built the AI Creative Intelligence Dashboard: Vibe-coded a tool that automates creative tagging and performance analysis, surfaces winning patterns, and turns them into reusable scripts and playbooks.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.label.en.text: Zenless Zone Zero: Social Launch in Japan

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.summary.en.text: I scaled an early network of social channels for Zenless Zone Zero in Japan to 9 channels and 80M+ organic views, while cutting cost per view by more than 50%.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.sections.0.items.0.text: I was on the Genshin Impact brand team, which had experience growing social channels, so the Zenless Zone Zero team asked us to launch its Japanese channels and hand them over once they could run on their own. There was little precedent for growing channels like these in Japan, so I had to learn the market while testing what worked, then turn scattered experiments into a system the Zenless Zone Zero team could take over, all within a limited timeframe.

nodes.ua-creative-strategy.team.en.text: Me (creative strategy, brand team), 1 UA strategist, 1 UA specialist and 4 agency partners. The UA team owned media buying and budget; I owned creative strategy and production.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.team.en.text: Me (social strategy), 2 content reviewers and 3 agency partners

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.sections.1.items.0.text: Defined the channel strategy: Researched Japanese player behavior, competitor channels and content gaps to match each channel to a niche with proven demand and room to grow, with clear content pillars across YouTube and X.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.sections.1.items.1.text: Ran biweekly growth reviews: Tracked every channel against its KPIs, diagnosed the ones falling behind and stepped in to redirect them.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.sections.1.items.2.text: Managed agency partners: Coordinated three agencies, aligning briefs, reviews and performance targets to lift content quality and cost efficiency.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.sections.1.items.a.text: Handed over a self-running system: Codified content learnings, KPIs and routines into playbooks, and transferred all nine channels to the Zenless Zone Zero team.

nodes.ua-creative-strategy.sections.1.it.text: Strengthened creator sourcing: Expanded regional talent pools through agency pitches and rotation, matching creators to the formats they perform best.

nodes.ua-creative-strategy.sections.0.it.text: I had to build the Brand-to-UA pipeline from scratch and prove, within a few game updates, that our creatives could earn spend and bring in quality players, not just add volume. The budget only covered smaller creators, so the content itself had to do the work.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.sections.1.items.a.text: Adapted winning formats: Identified the formats driving growth in each niche and brought them to stalled channels to restart growth.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.results.added-2f6c.text: Channels hitting view targets at handover

nodes.gip-testing.summary.en.text: I designed and ran a three-round testing framework to see whether TikTok’s UGC incentive program could boost installs efficiently.

nodes.gip-testing.sections.1.items.0.en.text: Designed the test framework: Built a three-round roadmap, setting each round’s payout model (CPM or CPA), markets, themes, budgets and success metrics against our UA benchmarks.

nodes.gip-testing.sections.1.items.1.en.text: Led campaign execution: Owned all three rounds end to end, from task setup and creator briefs to progress tracking, submission reviews and recaps.

nodes.gip-testing.sections.1.items.2.en.text: Raised content quality: Optimized creator task briefing, and flagged off-brief videos to free up the prize pool for better ones.

nodes.gip-testing.sections.1.items.3.en.text: Evaluated performance and drove the decision: Measured reach, CPI, user quality and content relevance against our UA benchmarks, then recommended stopping the program and shifting budget to creator ads for UA.

nodes.xbox-launch.team.en.text: Me (creative strategy), 1 media strategist, 2 creative producers and 1 agency partner

nodes.influencer-activation.summary.en.text: I rebuilt the creator strategy for a flagship Genshin Impact character launch on X, focusing on the creators core players actually follow. The campaign delivered 13M+ views at 8%+ engagement, about 3x the previous creator campaign at 39% lower CPM.

nodes.influencer-activation.sections.1.i.text: Refocused creators on core players: Replaced broad-appeal accounts with mid-tier artists, content creators and Genshin news accounts, so 80% of the roster spoke directly to core players.
Rebalanced markets and formats: Grew EN creators to half the roster, briefed a US agency on illustration styles North American players love, and kept JP momentum with artists and cosplayers.
Fixed the posting format: Moved creators from quote posts, which X tends to throttle, to native posts with the event link in a thread; in side-by-side tests, native posts drew up to 4–5x the views.
Led execution and benchmarking: Ran budget, sourcing, timelines and approvals across two agencies, then benchmarked results against the previous creator campaign to decide what to scale.
